# Load libraries

```{r}
library(tidyverse)
```

# Load data

## Ensembl v.109

Dataframe containing Ensembl gene ID, the version it was part of and which chromosome it was determined to be on. The data is gathered from the Ensembl website, and the version goes from v.32 to v.109.

```{r}
ensembl_data_v109 <- read_csv("../data/Ensembl/ensembl_data_v32_v109.csv")
ensembl_data_v109 <- rename(Ensembl = ensg_id)
head(ensembl_data_v109)
```

## UniProt v.24



```{r}
uniprot_data_v24 <- read_tsv("../data/UniProt/HPAv24_uniprot_pe1_5.txt")
head(uniprot_data_v24)

uniprot_data_v24 <- uniprot_data_v24 |> rename(Ensembl = ensg_id, Gene = display_name, UniProt = uniprot_id, UniProt_evidence = name) |>
  # Remove "UniProt - " Prefix from UniProt_evidence
  mutate(UniProt_evidence = str_remove(UniProt_evidence, "UniProt - ")) |>
  mutate(UniProt_evidence = case_when(UniProt_evidence == "Evidence at protein level" ~ "PE1: Evidence at protein level",
                                      UniProt_evidence == "Evidence at transcript level" ~ "PE2: Evidence at transcript level",
                                      UniProt_evidence == "Uncertain" ~ "PE3: Uncertain evidence",
                                      UniProt_evidence == "Inferred from homology" ~ "PE4: Inferred from homology",
                                      UniProt_evidence == "Predicted" ~ "PE5: Predicted evidence",
                                      TRUE ~ NA_character_)) |>
  distinct(Ensembl, .keep_all = TRUE) |> # Keep only the unique Ensembl genes
  select(Ensembl, Gene, UniProt, UniProt_evidence) |>
  mutate(Evidence_type = case_when(
    UniProt_evidence == "PE1: Evidence at protein level" ~ "UniProt evidence",
    UniProt_evidence == "PE2: Evidence at transcript level" ~ "UniProt evidence",
    UniProt_evidence == "PE3: Uncertain evidence" ~ "No UniProt evidence",
    UniProt_evidence == "PE4: Inferred from homology" ~ "No UniProt evidence",
    UniProt_evidence == "PE5: Predicted evidence" ~ "No UniProt evidence",
    TRUE ~ NA_character_
  )) |>
  mutate(Dataset = "UniProt")
  
head(uniprot_data_v24)
```

## HPA v.24

The HPA v.24 file is gathered from the `www.proteinatlas.org` website, where most boxes were ticked in to get the most comprehensive data. The file contains information on RNA and protein evidence for each gene, including tissue, brain, cell type, immune cell type, and cell line data, and more.

```{r}
hpa_data_v24 <- read_csv("../data/HPA v.24/hpa_data_v24.csv")
```

## HPA v.25

Here we are preparing the updated HPA version 25 data with the latest RNA and protein evidence.

RNA: Included the maximum nTPM values for tissue, brain, cell type, immune cell type, and cell line data.
Protein: Only contains "Enhanced" & "Supported" evidence levels from immunoflorescence, immunohistochemistry, and western blot.

### RNA (update)

We are considering RNA evidence if >= 1 nTPM is present in the dataset. The datasets are tissue, brain, cell type, immune cell type, and cell line.

```{r}
# RNA bulk

## Tissue
tissue_data <- read_tsv("../data/HPA v.25/datasets/RNA/rna_tissue_consensus.tsv")
head(tissue_data)

tissue_evidence <- tissue_data |>
  group_by(Gene) |>
  summarise(max_ntpm = max(nTPM)) |>
  mutate(Evidence_type = ifelse(max_ntpm >= 1, "Tissue evidence", "No tissue evidence")) |>
  mutate(Dataset = "Tissue") |>
  rename(Ensembl = Gene)
head(tissue_evidence)

## Brain
brain_data <- read_tsv("../data/HPA v.25/datasets/RNA/rna_brain_region_hpa.tsv")
head(brain_data)

brain_evidence <- brain_data |>
  group_by(Gene) |>
  summarise(max_ntpm = max(nTPM)) |>
  mutate(Evidence_type = ifelse(max_ntpm >= 1, "Brain evidence", "No brain evidence")) |>
  mutate(Dataset = "Brain") |>
  rename(Ensembl = Gene)
head(brain_evidence)

# Single-cell

## Cell-type
cell_type_data <- read_tsv("../data/HPA v.25/datasets/RNA/rna_single_cell_cluster.tsv")
head(cell_type_data)

cell_type_evidence <- cell_type_data |>
  group_by(Gene) |>
  summarise(max_ntpm = max(nTPM)) |>
  mutate(Evidence_type = ifelse(max_ntpm >= 1, "Cell type evidence", "No cell type evidence")) |>
  mutate(Dataset = "Cell type") |>
  rename(Ensembl = Gene)
head(cell_type_evidence)

## Immune cell type
immune_data <- read_tsv("../data/HPA v.25/datasets/RNA/rna_immune_cell.tsv")
head(immune_data)

immune_cell_type_evidence <- immune_data |>
  group_by(Gene) |>
  summarise(max_ntpm = max(nTPM)) |>
  mutate(Evidence_type = ifelse(max_ntpm >= 1, "Immune cell type evidence", "No immune cell type evidence")) |>
  mutate(Dataset = "Immune cell type") |>
  rename(Ensembl = Gene)
head(immune_cell_type_evidence)

# Cell line
cell_line_data <- read_tsv("../data/HPA v.25/datasets/RNA/rna_celline.tsv")
head(cell_line_data)

cell_line_evidence <- cell_line_data |>
  group_by(Gene) |>
  summarise(max_ntpm = max(nTPM)) |>
  mutate(Evidence_type = ifelse(max_ntpm >= 1, "Cell line evidence", "No cell line evidence")) |>
  mutate(Dataset = "Cell line") |>
  rename(Ensembl = Gene)
head(cell_line_evidence)
```

### Protein (update)

Currently we get the antibody reliability scores from the HPA v.24 file, but we will update this to the v.25 file in the future.

```{r}
# Protein-level corrections
## Remove protein-level evidence for genes that have only multi-target antibodies
multi_target_data <- read_tsv("../data/HPA v.25/datasets/Protein/genes_with_only_multitarget_abs.txt")
multi_target_data <- multi_target_data |> rename(Ensembl = ensg_id, Gene = display_name)
head(multi_target_data)

# Antibody-based evidence

## Western blot (WB)
wb_data <- read_delim("../data/HPA v.25/datasets/Protein/wb_scores.txt", delim = "\t", col_names = TRUE, show_col_types = FALSE)
wb_data <- wb_data |> rename(Ensembl = ensembl_gene_id, Gene = gene_name, `Reliability (WB)` = score_group_name) |> select(Ensembl, Gene, `Reliability (WB)`)
head(wb_data)

# Western blot as a long-format evidence block
wb_evidence <- wb_data %>%
  # Supported genes give Western blot evidence
  mutate(Evidence_type = ifelse(`Reliability (WB)` == "Supported", "Western blot evidence", "No western blot evidence")) %>%
  mutate(Dataset = "Western blot") %>%
  # Change Evidence column to "No western blot evidence" for genes with only multi-target antibodies
  mutate(Evidence_type = ifelse(Ensembl %in% multi_target_data$Ensembl, "No western blot evidence", Evidence_type)) # Remove Multi-target assays to have evidence
head(wb_evidence)

## Immunofluorescence (IF)
if_data <- read_tsv("../data/HPA v.25/datasets/Protein/subcellular_location_data.tsv") 
head(if_data)
  
if_evidence <- if_data |>
  rename(Ensembl = Gene, Gene = `Gene name`, `Reliability (IF)` = Reliability) |>
  select(Ensembl, Gene, `Reliability (IF)`) |>
  # Supported and Enhanced status give immunofluorescence evidence
  mutate(Evidence_type = ifelse(`Reliability (IF)` %in% c("Enhanced", "Supported"), "Immunofluorescence evidence", "No immunofluorescence evidence")) |>
  mutate(Dataset = "Immunofluorescence") |>
  # Change Evidence column to "No immunofluorescence evidence" for genes with only multi-target antibodies
  mutate(Evidence_type = ifelse(Ensembl %in% multi_target_data$Ensembl, "No immunofluorescence evidence", Evidence_type))
head(if_evidence)

## Immunohistochemistry (IHC)
ihc_data <- read_tsv("../data/HPA v.25/datasets/Protein/normal_ihc_data.tsv")
head(ihc_data)

ihc_evidence <- ihc_data |>
  rename(Ensembl = Gene, Gene = `Gene name`, `Reliability (IHC)` = Reliability) |>
  select(Ensembl, Gene, `Reliability (IHC)`) |>
  # Supported and Enhanced status give immunohistochemistry evidence
  mutate(Evidence_type = ifelse(`Reliability (IHC)` %in% c("Enhanced", "Supported"), "Immunohistochemistry evidence", "No immunohistochemistry evidence")) |>
  mutate(Dataset = "Immunohistochemistry") |>
  # Change Evidence column to "No immunohistochemistry evidence" for genes with only multi-target antibodies
  mutate(Evidence_type = ifelse(Ensembl %in% multi_target_data$Ensembl, "No immunohistochemistry evidence", Evidence_type))
head(ihc_evidence)
```

## Combine RNA and protein evidence

We are also adding information from the HPA v.24 file to the new v.25 file.
* Enrichment annotation (v.24)
* UniProt mapping (v.24)
* Chromosome and position information (v.24)
* Gene synonym information (v.24)
* Biological and functional annotation (GO + protein class) (v.24)

### Without annotations

```{r}
# Define which datasets are RNA and which are protein
rna_datasets <- c("Tissue", "Brain", "Cell type", "Cell line", "Immune cell type")
protein_datasets <- c("Western blot", "Immunofluorescence", "Immunohistochemistry")

# Step 1: Combine as before
hpa_evidence_v25 <- bind_rows(
  tissue_evidence,
  cell_type_evidence,
  immune_cell_type_evidence,
  brain_evidence,
  cell_line_evidence,
  wb_evidence,
  if_evidence,
  ihc_evidence
) 

# Step 2: Summarize evidence for each Ensembl gene (RNA and protein separately)
summary_evidence <- hpa_evidence_v25 %>%
  group_by(Ensembl) %>%
  summarise(
    # Transcript/RNA-level evidence
    RNA_evidence = any(
      Dataset %in% rna_datasets & grepl("evidence$", Evidence_type) & !grepl("^No ", Evidence_type)
    ),
    # Protein-level evidence
    Protein_evidence = any(
      Dataset %in% protein_datasets & grepl("evidence$", Evidence_type) & !grepl("^No ", Evidence_type)
    ),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    `Evidence annotation (transcript)` = ifelse(RNA_evidence, "Evidence on transcript level", "No evidence"),
    `Evidence annotation (protein)` = ifelse(Protein_evidence, "Evidence on protein level", "No evidence")
  )

# Step 3: Join the two new annotation columns back to the main table
hpa_evidence_v25 <- hpa_evidence_v25 %>%
  left_join(
    summary_evidence %>% select(Ensembl, `Evidence annotation (transcript)`, `Evidence annotation (protein)`),
    by = "Ensembl"
  ) |>
  # Add column called `HPA evidence` that takes 
  mutate(`HPA evidence` = case_when(
      `Evidence annotation (transcript)` == "Evidence on transcript level" & `Evidence annotation (protein)` == "Evidence on protein level" ~ "Evidence on protein level",
      `Evidence annotation (transcript)` != "Evidence on transcript level" & `Evidence annotation (protein)` == "Evidence on protein level" ~ "Evidence on protein level",
      `Evidence annotation (transcript)` == "Evidence on transcript level" & `Evidence annotation (protein)` != "Evidence on protein level" ~ "Evidence on transcript level",
      TRUE ~ "No evidence"
    ))
# Example: Count unique Ensembl genes for each combination of annotations
hpa_evidence_v25 %>%
  distinct(Ensembl, .keep_all = TRUE) %>%
  count(`Evidence annotation (transcript)`, `Evidence annotation (protein)`)

hpa_evidence_v25 %>%
  distinct(Ensembl, .keep_all = TRUE) %>%
  count(`HPA evidence`)
```
